about: Hand decisions about MLA1 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). Every one was read off the page image (survey apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/mla1.md, Stat blocks, the misprints tables; decisions 5 and 6); none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header, codes}: the printed page in the Adventure Book, the start of the entry's header, and where one card holds more than one block the block's seven codes as read
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
label       a second block on one card that prints no label of its own; 'label' is the name it is shown under

rows        the grid prints fewer than seven rows; 'abilities' are its rows as the page gives them, a row it does not print as null, and 'corrected' is how that row is played (null: the book leaves it to the GM); health, karma, resources and popularity as printed

text        a mark in the prose only the page image settles; match {row} is the msh_book_text key, 'read' the few words as the OCR gives them and 'printed' as the page does. scripts/msh/npcs.py stops if 'read' is not found exactly once in its row
also      further values of the same block, each {verdict, field, printed, and corrected for a misprint}: one override matches one block, and a block can print more than one thing to explain
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Printed Karma: 11 (printed 8): R, I and P each print PR (4), every row's code agreeing with its number, so R + I + P = 12 and the total is the misprint; Health 28 holds. Survey decision 5.

Printed Karma: 22 (printed 55): R EX (20), I TY (6), P TY (6), each code agreeing with its number, so R + I + P = 32. Reading R as GD (10) would change a row whose code and number agree, so the total is the misprint. Survey decision 5.
Printed Karma: 8 (printed 61): R TY (6), I PR (4), P FE (2), each code agreeing with its number, so R + I + P = 12 and the total is the misprint, as for Eel; Health 70 holds. Survey decision 5.

Printed A GD 12 with no brackets and E TY (7) (printed 8): each inside its rank's range (Good 8-15, Typical 5-7) but not its standard number, and Health 31 = 6 + 12 + 6 + 7 holds on them, so both are kept as printed in one override. Survey decision 6.

Printed Health: 80 over four RM (30) rows (printed 53, the zombie inside the Black Talon's Necromancy power): his text gives a zombie's Health as his own Power rank number, 80, and the skeleton's as half of it, 40, which F + A + S + E also gives. The book's rule, not a misprint. Survey decision 5.
Printed Karma: NA, with Resources and Popularity NA (printed 60): a robot, as MA1 prints a dash for the same machine and MX1's sentinels print Karma 0. Left unset. Survey decision 5.
